list: outputs_v3 top 15 (resolution rule: a beat resolves only if it opens no new question)
method: Two blind sheets (15+14 clips, then 4+4), shuffled, system hidden, rated from script text by the author. Baseline clips are the last 45 s of episodes.
caveats: One rater who knows the show; sheet 1 had 4 same-episode pairs and 1 unrated clip; ~15-18 clips per side; directional, not tested for significance.
